rows.what: 1 reference(s) use the prefix "CR", which no type declares
rows.why: A reference edge is drawn only for an id this repository declares — a loaded artifact, or a token starting with a template's `idPrefix` — so these 1 mention(s) across 1 file(s) drew nothing, and impact analysis under-reports by exactly that much with a number that looks fine. For example: CR-001. Declare a type whose `idPrefix` is "CR" and these become traced references; if they are safety or security identifiers, declare the role that binds them instead — those sections are read only when the role is declared. Sometimes correct: the prefix may belong to another tool's identifiers — a change request, a drawing number, a supplier's part — in which case nothing is missing, and this line is the confirmation that Sanad is not silently treating them as something they are not. Severity becomes a customer-set option at the read-ledger config stage (#658).
